project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Mappers
project.description: The runtime field-mapping engine: walks a TransformSpec/FieldRule list (D3, corrected) and dispatches each field through forwardmeasure-data-streaming-transforms' NamedTransformRegistry, ported directly from forwardmeasure-entity-intelligence's own GenericRecordMapper (minus its Protobuf-specific coercion step, which is D1's separate, explicitly-deferred concern - see the design plan's §5). Produces a schema-agnostic Map<String,Object> per row today; typed coercion against a generated OpenAPI model class (D1) is real follow-on work, not yet built. Not MapStruct: this mapping is metadata-driven (a new source is onboarded by writing a new TransformSpec, not by generating or compiling new Java code) - MapStruct's real place in this architecture is JPA entity-to-model conversion, in forwardmeasure-data-streaming-connector-jdbc.
